svg.aria-label: Sequence of one TCP connection through the inbound, the handler, the router and its rules, and the relay
svg.title: One TCP connection from accept to relay

g.text: Accept and handshake: each layer within its own handshake_timeout
Routing: the router walks the rules; a sniff action is bounded by its timeout (300ms)
Relay: until both sides finish, ctx is cancelled, or tcp_idle_timeout (5m) of silence
1. TCP connect (+ TLS / WS handshake if any)
8. informant.Sniff(sniffers, timeout): only if a rule sniffs
12. Sniffed result: the later rules read it
Solid arrows are calls or client bytes; dashed arrows are returns and replies. Steps 8-12 happen only when a rule's action is sniff; a rule that decides
before it skips them. A proxy outbound replaces steps 15-17: it dials the proxy server through its stack and calls the proxy client's RequestStream,
bounded by its handshake_timeout. When the decision is block, the handler closes the client stream and nothing is dialed.
